title: Franco declares victory in the Spanish Civil War
summary: General Francisco Franco announced that the war was over after Nationalist troops had taken Madrid and the last Republican forces had surrendered.
reason: The Republic was divided and exhausted after three years of fighting, while the Nationalists had steady support from Nazi Germany and Fascist Italy.
significance: It began Franco's dictatorship, which ruled Spain until 1975 and sent hundreds of thousands of Republicans into exile or prison.
